reason: Brachystylous means short-styled, which is one morph of a heterostylous species. It does not mean heterostylous in general.
The brown colour is lost. This is brown with mottling, not just mottled.
Bullulate means minutely bullate (finely blistered), so bullate is the nearest class. I did not find the definition of FLOPO_0991122 in the value-terms file.
Ciliate-fringed means fringed with cilia (short hairs). Fimbriate means a coarse, long fringe, which is not the same thing.
Covered with glandular hairs is glandular-pubescent.
Covered with hairs is hairy.
Desquamating is the same as peeling or flaking, which is exfoliating bark or surface.
Emerging means exserted only for parts that project out of a surrounding structure. For other parts, such as a seedling, it means something else.
Farineux is the French for mealy or farinose.
Foliaged means bearing leaves, which is leafy.
Flared fits only parts that widen towards an end. Gradually widening can also describe a leaf blade, which would be an outline shape instead.
Independent means free (not united) only for parts that could be fused. Elsewhere it has a non-botanical sense.
The target is a secondary leaf vein, so it is right only for leaves. Lateral nerves on other parts, such as bracts or sepals, would not be a leaf vein.
Liane-like means climbing like a liana.
The word light is lost. This is a light shade of chestnut, not the plain chestnut colour.
Lisse is the French for smooth.
Mamillate means bearing nipple-shaped projections. Tuberculate means bearing wart-like knobs, which is not the same.
The location is lost. The word means that the base is narrowed, not the whole organ.
Non-divergent means not spreading.
Non-exfoliating is the negation of exfoliating.
Non-protruding means not prominent.
Non-reticulate is the negation of reticulate (netted). I did not find the definition of FLOPO_0991100 in the value-terms file.
Non-revolute is the negation of revolute.
Non-scaly is the negation of scaly.
Not acuminate is the negation of acuminate.
Not acuminated is the negation of acuminate.
Not bifid is the negation of bifid. PATO has bifid as a synonym of bifurcated.
Not buttressed is the negation of buttressed.
Not muricate is the negation of muricate.
Obtus-arrondi means obtuse and rounded. Obtuse alone loses the rounded part.
Plan is the French for flat or level.
Poorly apparent means inconspicuous.
Pseudo-paniculate means panicle-like.
Rachisless means the rachis is absent.
Rayonnant is the French for radiating.
Semi-orbiculate means half-round, which is semicircular.
Unfissured means not fissured.
Unique, as a translation of the French, means a single one, which is solitary.

target: connate + basally (the base as the bearer or a position)
reason: The words at base are lost. The parts are united only at the base and may be free above.
A visible vein is a conspicuous vein, and the rule is limited to veins.
Wheel-like is the usual gloss of rotate, as in a rotate corolla.
Évasé is the French for flared.
Bad-smelling means foetid.
Dangling means pendent.
Bloom is the waxy coating, so lacking bloom means not glaucous.
Lacking endosperm means the endosperm is absent.
Spike-shaped means spike-like.
Circumferential means running around the circumference, as in circumscissile dehiscence. That is not the same as surrounding another structure.
Flattenuated looks like a blend of flattened and attenuated. Mapping it to flattened alone loses the attenuate part.
A jasmine scent is a sweet scent. The rule loses the type of scent but is accurate.
